questions.question: Is the free-shipping threshold of ₹1,500 calculated before or after a DiscountCode is applied?
questions.answer: The discounted subtotal decides: above ₹1,500 shipping is free, otherwise courier shipping is ₹99.

questions.question: At what stock level should a glaze count as nearly gone for planning the next batch, and should the owner be able to change that level per Piece?
questions.answer: A warning at 3 or fewer pieces left per glaze-and-size variant, with the threshold fixed for the MVP.

questions.question: Should studio pickup be offered only to buyers in Jaipur, or can any buyer choose pickup at checkout?
questions.answer: Buyers simply choose studio pickup or courier at checkout; no address check restricts who may pick up.

known.message: lookupOrder is a get with 2 inputs (FD24, FD11). A get takes no inputs, or the one field the user types to find its record. Keep that field and move the others to the operation that saves or lists.

createOrder creates Order lines with pieces, glaze, size and quantity but has only quantity FD09 and no glaze FD06, size FD07 or piece inputs. Fix: Add inputs for the chosen variants that create the order lines, such as FD06 as orderedGlaze and FD07 as orderedSize together with the Piece link, so createOrder knows which glaze-and-size variants and quantities were ordered.

updatePiece requires the full piece-form inputs but also serves the system stock reduce and restore updates where the user fills in nothing. Fix: List only F22.S02 in updatePiece and serve the F07.S02 reduce-stock and F18.S01 restore-stock Piece updates with separate update operations that do not require the full piece-form inputs.
